newsitem.title: TANZANIA: SOCCER-LIBERIA'S WEAH TIPS EUROPEAN TEAM FOR WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIBERIA'S WEAH TIPS EUROPEAN TEAM FOR WORLD CUP.

text.p: Liberian star striker George Weah says he expects a European team to win the World Cup to be played in France next year, Tanzania's Sunday News reported.

In an interview while in Tanzania for the African Nations' Cup qualifier -- in which Liberia's Lone Stars drew 1-1 with Tanzania's Taifa Stars on Saturday -- he said European clubs had the edge in superior training and facilities compared to their African counterparts.
"I would like to be convinced that in the coming World Cup, African teams will do better than before and be strong contenders for the trophy," said Weah who plays for AC Milan in Italy.
"However, European teams are still better placed because they have much better training facilities than the African teams."
Weah said his own success could be attributed to prayers, hard work and discipline. His main current wish was for his country, Liberia, suffering a bloody civil war, to become peaceful.
"It is after Liberia has become completely peaceful that I'll feel more comfortable," he said.
